title: AllowTrust that moves a trustline between authorized and authorized-to-maintain-liabilities records no CLEAR of the old flag
severity_basis: addAllowTrustEffects passes only setFlags for authorize 1 and 2, so a move between AUTHORIZED and AUTHORIZED_TO_MAINTAIN_LIABILITIES gets a BALANCE_AUTHORIZATION SET row for the new flag and no CLEAR for the flag stellar-core turned off; a client that rebuilds flags from the rows ends up with both bits set. AllowTrust is deprecated but valid (the issue states impact low).

entries.expected: a CLEAR row for the authorization flag that AllowTrust turned off
entries.observed: The kit's replay of this entry passes at e967ce8b: its expectation (trustline_flags_changed with the final flags) does not state the SET and CLEAR rows, so no row shows the missing CLEAR. By hand at 3e22515a: the issue's unit test records only SET [AUTHORIZED_TO_MAINTAIN_LIABILITIES] for authorize=2.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's unit test (internal/indexer/processors/allow_trust_clear_test.go) at 3e22515a fails: authorize=2 produces only SET [AUTHORIZED_TO_MAINTAIN_LIABILITIES] and no CLEAR [AUTHORIZED]; authorize=1 behaves the same way in reverse.
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-core's AllowTrust clears TRUSTLINE_AUTH_FLAGS before setting the new level (AllowTrustOpFrame.cpp#L77-L79 at f2b91947); wallet-backend's state-changes.md defines BALANCE_AUTHORIZATION CLEAR as flags turned off.

reproduction.method: Re-run on 2026-11-18 with the issue's test at 3e22515a: fails with 'expected CLEAR of authorized'.

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-18: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-14 as https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/issues/811; this record restates the public issue.
